name: Pull-Up
imageEndCaption: Step 3: the chin is above the bar (Free Exercise DB)
steps: Hold the bar with your hands about shoulder width or a little wider.
Hang with straight arms and tight shoulders.
Pull your body up until your chin passes the bar.
Go down slowly to the start position.

name: Lat Pulldown
imageCaption: Lat pulldown, starting position (Free Exercise DB)
imageEndCaption: Step 3: the bar is pulled down to the upper chest (Free Exercise DB)
steps: Sit down at the machine with your feet flat on the floor.
Hold the bar wider than your shoulders.
Pull the bar down to your upper chest.
Let the bar go up slowly.

name: Bent-Over Barbell Row
imageCaption: Bent-over barbell row, starting position (Free Exercise DB)
imageEndCaption: Step 3: the bar is pulled to the stomach (Free Exercise DB)
steps: Stand with your knees a little bent.
Bend your upper body forward and keep your back straight.
Pull the bar to your stomach.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.

name: Seated Cable Row
imageCaption: Seated cable row, starting position (Free Exercise DB)
imageEndCaption: Step 3: the handle is pulled to the stomach (Free Exercise DB)
steps: Sit down and put your feet on the platform.
Hold the handle with straight arms.
Pull the handle to your stomach and squeeze your back.
Return slowly to the start position.

name: Bent-Over Dumbbell Row
imageCaption: Bent-over dumbbell row, starting position (Free Exercise DB)
imageEndCaption: Step 4: both dumbbells are pulled up to the waist (Free Exercise DB)
steps: Stand with your feet about hip width apart.
Hold one dumbbell in each hand and bend your knees a little.
Bend your upper body forward and keep your back straight.
Pull both dumbbells up to your waist.
Lower them slowly until your arms are straight.
